metadata.description: planfi skills — financial planning and real-estate investment analysis powered by the public planfi MCP.

plugins.name: financial-forecast
plugins.description: Build a complete FIRE / financial forecast: net-worth projection, FIRE age, Monte Carlo success rate, insights, action plan, what-if scenario comparisons, childcare cost + dependent-care FSA / Child & Dependent Care Credit / Child Tax Credit offsets with a corrected second-income tradeoff, and education/estate deep-dives including federal education tax credits (American Opportunity vs Lifetime Learning Credit per student, MAGI phase-out, refundable/non-refundable split, and the $4k 529 carve-out to preserve full AOTC), a 529→Roth rollover (SECURE 2.0) + 5-year gift-tax-averaged 529 superfunding optimizer, plus estate- and inheritance-tax exposure covering the 6 inheritance-tax states (PA/NJ/KY/IA/MD/NE, taxed by beneficiary relationship class regardless of estate size) and ~12 estate-tax states (MA/NY/OR/WA + CT/DC/HI/IL/ME/MD/MN/RI/VT), and a kiddie-tax & UTMA/UGMA funding planner (IRC §1(g) tier liability on a child's unearned income, appreciated-stock gifting into the child's 0% LTCG bracket, the UTMA-vs-529 FAFSA asset-treatment penalty, and annual gift-exclusion headroom). Thin orchestration over the planfi MCP.
